verificationRecords.command: npm run test:radical-reader-promotion; npm run test:canonical-animation-construction; npm run typecheck; npm run check:architecture
verificationRecords.notes: Four inventory ratchets, sixty released canonical-construction checks, all TypeScript projects and domain packages, and all architecture gates pass. The inventory freezes the existing radical authorities, explicit reader adoption gap, old editor/WebGL compatibility boundary, preservation contract, and rollback unit.

verificationRecords.command: npm run test:radical-reader-promotion; npm run typecheck; npm run check:architecture
verificationRecords.notes: Eight promotion inventory and cost-ratchet tests pass. The executable gate accepts only content, lesson/compiler, descriptor, selector-annotation, verification, and durable-evidence wiring; it rejects every protected compositor/scheduler core file, new lifecycle or scheduler categories, notation geometry, runtime artifacts, and unclassified production changes. Type and architecture gates pass.

verificationRecords.command: npm run test:radical-reader-promotion; npm run test:canonical-animation-construction; npm run typecheck; npm run check:architecture
verificationRecords.notes: Twelve radical inventory, promotion-cost, and preservation checks plus sixty released construction checks pass. The manifest freezes exact objects, LaTeX, operation, law, lineage, timeline, checkpoints, all seven structural focus selectors, generated learning/export artifacts, interaction, accessibility, responsive/DPR review profiles, exclusive paint policy, old editor residual, and unchanged reader budgets. Type and architecture gates pass.
All application, node, test, and domain projects passed.

verificationRecords.scope: slice 5 structural binding and lineage totality
verificationRecords.notes: 15 tests passed; every radical correspondence selector resolves through semantic annotation or an explicit compiler-owned structural binding.

verificationRecords.scope: slice 6 radical lesson content and model
verificationRecords.notes: 17 tests passed; prose, semantic authority, three checkpoints, and all seven focus selectors match the preservation manifest.
19 tests passed; exact source and target LaTeX, native KaTeX fraction/radical structure, three static MathML checkpoints, and hydration authority are present.
Existing numerator split/merge compiler and semantic-authority tests passed.
22 tests passed; radical, fraction, and solve-x compile canonical eligibility from descriptors with shared clock, IR lifecycle, and exclusive-native presentation authorities.
11 renderer convergence tests passed; entrypoint contains no lesson-specific canonical branch.
All existing descriptor resolution and capability tests passed.

verificationRecords.scope: slice 9 no-route canonical adapter dry run
verificationRecords.notes: One Chromium test passed. The governed radical frame compiled with no render/material diagnostics into the existing renderer session; persist/introduce/eliminate tracks were finite, seek-stable, and material-owned without activating a reader route.

Two Chromium tests passed on a scope-owned fresh Vite server. The real radical route used one canonical material layer, emptied compatibility paint, and assigned unanchored native radical SVG paint to its semantic state.
The radical reader route compiled into dist with native lesson HTML and shared reader chunks.
24 tests passed. Forward and rewind plans have inverse lifecycles and exact one-relation coverage for every selector.

Two Chromium tests passed. Dense 0-100 percent samples cover every source and target paint atom, keep persist tracks opaque, make genuine emergence and absorption monotonic, settle native endpoints, and reproduce exactly under reverse traversal.

verificationRecords.scope: slice 12 native endpoint microscope and fraction control
verificationRecords.notes: Seven Chromium tests passed. Radical target glyph rect, style, baseline, endpoint boxes, and native SVG path data are bounded before handoff; fraction ownership, seek/rewind, static, and phone controls pass.
52 compositor and typography handoff tests passed.

verificationRecords.scope: slice 13 radical time semantics and fraction control
verificationRecords.notes: Nine Chromium tests passed. Radical direct seek, rewind, repeated scrub, reduced-motion, native endpoint settlement, and no-JavaScript static projection are deterministic; fraction controls remain green.

verificationRecords.scope: slice 14 radical product seams and fraction control
verificationRecords.notes: Ten Chromium tests passed. Semantic DOM and MathML remain native; material paint is inert and authority-free; pointer and keyboard focus, URL/share restoration, phone transcript fallback, and no route-owned Cloze/export fork are verified.
34 focused tests passed, including governed radical hover/accessibility capability, generated card identity, iframe export, and static-step export semantics.
Built 38 self-contained wide/phone DPR1/2 full/reduced frames plus fraction controls; geometry is stable, with native focus-color continuity retained for human slice-16 review.

verificationRecords.scope: slice 15 responsive browser and fraction controls
verificationRecords.notes: Ten Chromium tests passed: radical adapter, ownership, pre-handoff geometry, seek/rewind, reduced/static, product seams, and fraction functional controls.

verificationRecords.scope: slice 15 checkpoint plan and focused regressions
verificationRecords.notes: Thirty-five tests passed, including the exact 38-frame responsive/DPR/handoff checkpoint matrix.
Concept-room, semantic-reader, and semantic-animation architecture gates passed.
Validated 791 nodes and 12810 events before checkpoint completion.

verificationRecords.command: manual review of generated radical checkpoint
verificationRecords.notes: Clarification: the 99.9-to-100 geometry is continuous, but the persistent x focus color is discontinuous from black material paint to orange native paint. This is deliberately retained only as a human-checkpoint finding for generic slice-16 repair.
Shared scrubber, dense persistent-x continuity, wide/phone and DPR 1/2 pass.
Radical and fraction ownership, geometry, time, accessibility, focus, static, and responsive seams pass.
Typecheck and production build pass; reader and canonical-animation budgets remain within limits.

verificationRecords.command: manual live browser review of canonical host parity
verificationRecords.notes: Human checkpoint rejected: both experiment and reader reduce exponent notation to eliminate/introduction opacity tracks. Cross-host parity proved shared ownership but missed common-mode loss of the accepted solid radical morph.

progress.summary: HUMAN_CHECKPOINT rejected. Diagnose and repair the common-mode fade-only structural succession before extracting a promotion kit or continuing slices 17-20.

expectedLearning: Whether radical succession can become a canonical reader exemplar with exact native endpoints and no new runtime category.
Whether the resulting promotion kit makes unit-exponent adoption content-and-wiring work only.
allowedWork: Execute only the approved radical reader adoption and promotion-kit contract.
Preserve and verify native reader semantics, accessibility, responsive behavior, seek, rewind, export, and production closure.
disallowedWork: Do not generalize to a radical family or implement later foldable-distribution and domain loops.
Do not add notation-specific geometry, a second runtime or clock, or model-authored mathematical or visual authority.
